Staff Product Manager, Payment Integrity Platform
Acme Health
Location: Remote (US)

About Acme Health
Acme Health builds software that helps health plans pay claims accurately.

What you'll do:
- Own the product strategy and roadmap for our payment integrity platform.
- Partner with engineering and executive stakeholders to define product strategy.
- Drive platform scalability and performance improvements across multiple engineering teams.
- Lead discovery with health plan customers to identify high-value audit workflows.

Requirements:
- 8+ years of product management experience, including B2B SaaS platforms.
- Experience in healthcare payer, claims, or payment integrity domains.
- Experience building healthcare AI products with Python.
- Track record of leading cross-functional teams of engineers, data scientists, and designers.

Preferred qualifications:
- Experience with machine learning model deployment.
- SQL proficiency and comfort working with large datasets.
- MBA or advanced degree.

Benefits:
- Competitive salary and equity.
